rules.title: Annual Allowable Rent Increase for Rent-Controlled Units (3/1/26-2/28/27)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount is 1.6% effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027. Calculated by multiplying tenant's base rent by 0.016.
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled units in San Francisco; effective period March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027

field_evidence.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
To calculate the dollar amount of the 1.6% annual rent increase, multiply the tenant's base rent by .016.

evidence.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
